new.title: Plan a trip
new.loadError: The trip form couldn't be loaded.

place.timezoneHint: The trip's “today” follows the first destination's time zone; with none chosen, it is yours.
place.name: Place
place.full: That's as many destinations as one trip takes ({{max}}).
place.endError: Choose a last day on or after the first.
place.tooLong: A trip can be up to {{max}} days long.

people.hint: Add everyone going. A passport country is each person's own, and optional.
people.none: Nobody added yet. You can save the trip without anyone, and add them later.
people.name: Name
people.passportHint: Kept with the trip only. Nothing is guessed from it.
people.expiryHint: Only if you want it kept with the trip. Nothing is worked out from it.
people.full: That's as many travellers as one trip takes ({{max}}).

style.paceHint: How full you like the days.
style.interestsHint: Separate them with commas: beaches, food, museums.
style.interestsError: Up to {{max}} interests, each up to 40 letters.
style.remind: Remind me the day before it starts
style.remindHint: One reminder. It moves with the dates, and goes if the trip does.
style.remindTooLate: It starts today or has started, so there's no day before it left to remind you on.

static.body: Everything works, without AI: you plan the trip yourself, step by step.

basic.body: AI drafts for you to check: the trip from your words, a day's plan, an activity's checklist, a change. Nothing is saved until you apply it. Use is limited each day, and whenever AI isn't available the trip works as Static.

premium.body: Not available yet, so it can't be chosen.

describe.title: Describe your trip
describe.offer: With Basic AI, describe the trip in your own words and it drafts these steps for you to check. Nothing is saved until you save the trip.
describe.useBasic: Use Basic AI for this trip
describe.basicOn: This trip is in Basic AI. You can change that at “{{step}}”.
describe.example: For example: “Goa with friends, 20 to 24 November, relaxed, beaches and seafood”.
describe.manual: Or fill in the steps yourself below.
describe.ready: A draft is ready. Check it, then fill in the steps with it or cancel.
describe.yours: Who's going, notes and the reminder stay yours to fill in.
describe.filled: Filled in from your words. Check every step, then save the trip.

review.intro: This is the trip as it will be saved. Change any part with its Edit button.
review.title: Trip name

conflict: This was changed somewhere else since you opened it. Reload it, then make your change again.

tripPage.notFound: This trip isn't here. It may have been deleted.

overview.nothingAhead: Nothing planned is still to come.

settings.keeps: Changing the mode changes nothing else: every activity, list, booking and cost stays as it is.

tripEdit.title: Edit “{{title}}”
tripEdit.intro: Only what you change is saved. Its plan, lists, bookings and costs stay as they are.
tripEdit.deleteBody: It goes from your trips with everything in it, its reminder too. Nothing in it is lost: you can bring it back straight after.

itinerary.empty: Nothing planned for this day yet.
itinerary.emptyBody: Add what you'd like to do, in the order you'd like to do it.
itinerary.loadError: This trip's plan couldn't be loaded.

activity.name: What
activity.durationError: Write a whole number of minutes, like 90.
activity.confirmedHint: Off: the time, place and cost are an estimate.

change.previewIntro: Nothing has changed yet. This is what it would do.
change.undone: Taken back: everything it changed is as it was.
change.unchanged: Nothing changed: it was already that way, so there's nothing to undo.
change.asSaved: This is just as it's saved, so there's nothing to change.

changes.review: For you to look at (nothing here changes them)

reasons.estimate: “{{title}}” is an estimate that may no longer stand.
reasons.linked: The booking “{{title}}” goes with it: change or cancel it with whoever it's with.
reasons.edited: “{{title}}” has your changes, so it's kept.

checklist.nowWaiting: “{{title}}”: {{state}}. Kept on this device until the network is back.
checklist.name: What

prepare.pick: Or a day of the trip
prepare.loadError: This day's plan couldn't be loaded.
prepare.outside: This day isn't one of the trip's, so nothing is planned on it. What's to do for the whole trip is below.
prepare.openDay: Open this day in the itinerary
prepare.noChecklist: Nothing to do that day yet.
prepare.noWholeTrip: Nothing to do for the whole trip yet.

bookings.intro: Kept as you enter them: the app doesn't look anything up, or check them with anyone.
bookings.emptyBody: Add the ones you have: flights, stays, tours, insurance and the like.
bookings.noActivity: No activity goes with it yet.
bookings.activitiesError: Which activities go with it couldn't be loaded.
bookings.linkNone: Every planned activity already goes with a booking, or none is planned yet.

booking.name: What
booking.nameHint: For example, “Flight out” or “Hotel, first two nights”.
booking.referenceHint: A PNR, a confirmation or a policy number.
booking.endsError: It ends at or after it starts.
booking.linkError: A web address that starts with http:// or https://.
booking.confirmed: I checked it with whoever it's with
booking.confirmedHint: Off: it's kept as you entered it.

packing.loadError: The packing list couldn't be loaded.
packing.emptyBody: Add what to bring, bag by bag, or ask for suggestions from the trip's activities and length.
packing.nothingNeeded: Nothing here is needed any more.

suggest.intro: Nothing is added yet. These are common-sense suggestions from the trip's own activities and length, not requirements of any place or company.
suggest.none: Nothing new to suggest: what fits is on your lists already, or you removed it.
suggest.more: There are more: ask again once these are added.

suggestions.booking_details: Booking details, if you have them
suggestions.pickup_details: Meeting point or pickup details, if any
suggestions.ticket_details: Ticket or booking details, if you have them
suggestions.shopping_bag: A bag for what you buy
suggestions.meeting_papers: Papers and notes for the meeting
suggestions.power_adapter: A power adapter, if you need one

ai.nothing: It didn't draft anything this time.
ai.ready: A draft is ready. Check it, then add it or cancel.

day.title: Draft {{day}}
day.about: The assistant drafts activities for this day from the trip's places, pace and interests, and what the day already holds. You check them before anything is added.
day.example: For example: “a slow morning and a seafood lunch”.
day.manual: Or add activities yourself with “Add an activity”.
day.intro: Nothing is added yet. These go after what the day already holds, as estimates with no booking, and nothing there moves or changes.

items.label: Prepare with AI: {{title}}
items.title: Prepare for “{{title}}”
items.about: The assistant drafts what to bring and do for this activity, from what it is and what's on your lists already. You check them before anything is added.
items.manual: Or add items yourself with “Add an item” in Prepare.
items.intro: Nothing is added yet. These are the assistant's suggestions for this activity, not requirements of any place or company.
items.none: Nothing new: what it drafted is on your lists already, or you removed it.
items.rules: Here are the app's own suggestions for this kind of activity instead: by rule, not by AI.
items.rulesIntro: Nothing is added yet. These come from the app's own rules for this kind of activity, not from AI, and aren't requirements of any place or company.
items.noRules: The app has no suggestions of its own for this kind of activity.

change.label: Tell it what changed: {{title}}
change.title: What happened with “{{title}}”?
change.about: Say it in your words. The assistant drafts the change (done, skipped, replaced or moved), and you see what it would do before anything changes.
change.example: For example: “we skipped it, it rained” or “moved to Saturday at 10”.
change.manual: Or use Mark done, Skip, Replace or Reschedule on the Itinerary yourself.
change.drafted: Drafted from your words. Check it, then see what it changes.

ask.title: Ask about this trip
ask.about: It answers from this trip's plan, lists and budget. It can't know the weather, prices, opening hours or entry rules.
ask.example: For example: “What's planned for Saturday?” or “How much of the budget is left?”
ask.manual: Or look through the trip's sections yourself.
ask.check: It answers from this trip's records and can be wrong: the trip's sections are the record.
ask.none: It had no answer this time.

budget.inCurrency: In {{currency}}, from the costs below. An activity's own estimated cost stays with the activity, and isn't counted here.
budget.unconvertedIntro: There's no exchange rate to {{currency}} for these just now, so they're left out rather than guessed.

reasons.unavailable: No rate could be had just now: look again later.
reasons.unsupported: There's no rate for this currency.

budget.noCostsBody: Add what you expect to spend, and what you really spend as you go.
budget.sharedHint: From what was really spent and who paid it, split evenly among those sharing each cost. Estimates don't count.
budget.fewTravellers: Costs are split between the trip's travellers, and it has fewer than two.

expense.name: What
expense.dayHint: Another currency is converted at that day's rate, or today's for a day still to come or no day. With no rate for that very day, the cost is listed apart, never guessed.
expense.sharedHint: Split evenly among those ticked. None ticked: it's the payer's own.

budgetForm.title: The trip's budget
budgetForm.hint: Leave it empty for no budget.

history.empty: Nothing has changed on this trip yet.
history.loadError: This trip's history couldn't be loaded.
history.staleHint: Only the latest change to something can be undone. Undo its newer changes first, or change it back yourself.

errors.TRAVEL_ACTIVITIES_FULL: That's as many activities as one trip keeps.
errors.TRAVEL_ACTIVITY_STATE: Only a planned activity can change this way. Undo its last change first.
errors.TRAVEL_REORDER_MISMATCH: This day changed somewhere else. Reload it and try again.
errors.TRAVEL_DAY_OUTSIDE_TRIP: That day isn't within the trip's dates.
errors.TRAVEL_CHECKLIST_FULL: That's as many items as one trip keeps.
errors.TRAVEL_ACTIVITY_UNKNOWN: That activity isn't on this trip any more.
errors.TRAVEL_CHECKLIST_DAY_MISMATCH: An item tied to an activity stays on that activity's day.
errors.TRAVEL_SUGGESTION_TAKEN: These suggestions were just added somewhere else. Close this and look again.
errors.TRAVEL_UNDO_STALE: Something it touched has changed since, so it can't be undone.
errors.TRAVEL_BOOKINGS_FULL: That's as many bookings as one trip keeps.
errors.TRAVEL_BOOKING_UNKNOWN: That booking isn't on this trip any more.
errors.TRAVEL_BOOKING_IN_USE: An activity still goes with this booking: unlink it first.
errors.TRAVEL_EXPENSES_FULL: That's as many costs as one trip keeps.
errors.TRAVEL_TRAVELLER_UNKNOWN: That traveller isn't on this trip any more.
errors.TRAVEL_ACTIVITIES_OUTSIDE_DATES: Some activities would fall outside the trip's dates.
errors.TRAVEL_CHECKLIST_OUTSIDE_DATES: Some checklist items would fall outside the trip's dates.
errors.TRAVEL_TRAVELLER_IN_USE: A traveller still has checklist items or costs on this trip.
errors.TRAVEL_AI_OFF: AI help is only for a trip in Basic AI. Switch the trip to it in its settings, or go on by hand.
errors.TRAVEL_AI_RUN_INVALID: That AI draft can't be used here any more. Ask again, or do it by hand.
errors.TRAVEL_AI_DRAFT_APPLIED: This draft was added to the day already. To add it again, undo that in History first.
